body:
# **✨ Welcome to Silvermons! ✨**

**Silvermons** is a non pay-to-win friendly community Cobblemon server with content for both casual and competitive players. The server has a custom quest-based storyline that progresses you through a level cap and rank system by completing content, including:
- ⚖️ Gyms
- 🤜 Elite 4
- 🏰 Conqueror's Castle
- 🗡️ Master's Gauntlet

# **🚀 Additional Features 🚀**

Beyond this progression system, the server has content for players of all interests:
- 🏆 Weekly Tournaments with Multiple Semi-Custom Formats
- 🥊 Player Gyms System with Two Modes: Base and Expert Mode
- 🚀 Weekly Content: Battle Tower, Noble 6, Battle Factory, Santum of Souls, Bingo, and more!
- 📖 Quest System: Progression/Main Quest Line, Side Quests, Daily and Weekly Quests
- ⚔️ Ranked PvP System with Multiple Semi-Custom Formats
- 🐲 Group Raids, Hunts, Wordle, and Chat Games
- 🏅 Daily and Weekly Leaderboards and Shared Server Daily Tasks
- 🎯 Challenges and Milestones System, including our Monotype Challenge
- 🏪 Player Driven Economy with Player Shops, Global Trade System, Auction House, and Dark Auctions
- 🎫 Many Tags and Plushies to Collect
- 🗳️ Vote Rewards, Milestones, and Vote Party
- 📱 Pokédex Rewards
- ⏱️ Playtime Rewards
- 👻 Custom Blocks
- 🏘️ Guilds

Our server also contains all **1,025 Pokémon**, the new Mega Evolutions and Move Changes, generational gimmicks like Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, and Tera, and many other unique systems to explore! Come join the community!

# **🌎 How to join! 🌍**
- Server IP: **play.silvermons.com**
- Discord: **discord.gg/silvermons**
- We are running Cobblemon Fabric on Minecraft 1.21.1
- Recommended Modpack: **[Silvermons (Cobblemon)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/silvermons-(cobblemon))**
